item.title: ‘UNDERDOGS’ PSVR 2 Port Won’t Get Multiplayer Due to Low Player Numbers
item.description: UNDERDOGS (2024) landed on PSVR 2 back in March 2025, making the popular physics-based mech brawler available across all major VR headsets. While the game is slated to get full multiplayer support on Quest and SteamVR, PSVR 2 owners won’t be so lucky. item.title: New Reference Design From Key Manufacturer Shows What to Expect From MR Headsets in 2026
item.description: A Chinese company which mass produces many of the best known headsets in the industry has shared a new compact MR headset reference design which sets expectations for 2026. Goertek is a little-known but massively important player in the XR industry. The company is a key enabler in the production of XR headsets as it […] The post New Reference Design From Key Manufacturer Shows What to Expect From MR Headsets in 2026 appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Meta’s Language Learning App for Quest Combines Mixed Reality and AI
item.description: Meta released an open source language learning app for Quest 3 that combines mixed reality passthrough and AI-powered object recognition. The News Called Spatial Lingo: Language Practice, the app not only aims to help users practice their English or Spanish using objects in their own room, but also give developers a framework to make their […] The post Meta’s Language Learning App for Quest Combines Mixed Reality and AI appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Meta Waveguide Provider Claims “world’s first” 70° FoV Waveguide
item.description: Lumus, the company that developed the waveguide optic used in Meta’s Ray-Ban Display smart glasses, says it has achieved a 70° field-of-view in a new design revealed this week at CES 2026. This conveniently matches the 70° field-of-view that Meta achieved in its ‘Orion’ prototype, but only with the use of novel materials. The News […] The post Meta Waveguide Provider Claims “world’s first” 70° FoV Waveguide appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Steam Reveals Most Played PC VR Games of 2025
item.description: Steam has unveiled its mega list of the most played PC VR games of 2025. And it looks to be another year of ‘old reliables’, as the top 50 only features a single game released that year. Valve released its annual “best of” games list, again offering insight into what PC VR people are playing […] The post Steam Reveals Most Played PC VR Games of 2025 appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Google’s Leading AR Glasses Partner XREAL Raises $100M
item.description: XREAL, the Beijing-based AR glasses maker, announced it has raised $100 million in a recent funding round. item.title: Meta Reportedly Laying Off 10 Percent of Reality Labs, Shifting Focus from VR & Horizon Worlds
item.description: Meta is slated to layoff around 10 percent of staff at its Reality Labs XR division, a New York Times report maintains, as the company appears to be shifting focus to AI and smart glasses. The News According to three people with knowledge of internal discussions, cuts could come as early as today, and could […] The post Meta Reportedly Laying Off 10 Percent of Reality Labs, Shifting Focus from VR & Horizon Worlds appeared first on Road to VR.

item.title: Meta Reportedly Closes Three First-party Studios Behind Some of Its Biggest VR Games
item.description: Against the backdrop of a broader shuffling of its Reality Labs division, Meta is reportedly closing Armature Studio, Twisted Pixel, and Sanzaru Games, three studios that Meta had previously acquired. The studios were behind some of the company’s biggest first-party VR games, including Deadpool VR, Asgard’s Wrath, and the Resident Evil 4 Quest port. According to reports […] The post Meta Reportedly Closes Three First-party Studios Behind Some of Its Biggest VR Games appeared first on Road to VR.

item.description: Meta has closed at least three of its XR studios, and seems to have also drastically reduced its budget for third-party Quest content too, reportedly including a now-cancelled Harry Potter VR title. item.title: Meta Aims to Double, Possibly Even Triple Smart Glasses Production This Year
item.description: Meta and EssilorLuxottica are potentially set to double the expected production target for their smart glasses, according to a recent Bloomberg report.
